g.text: RPC-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: vm-object
processor-zero VM object body; root ownership stable
until strong phase closes
symbols-keywords
processor-zero symbol/key table roots; table bodies
use object scan semantics
globals
all processors partition SINGLE_VM sublists or per-VM
global slots using floor endpoints; fixed n and np
required
continuation-denv
each processor live stack with frame GC map plus
break-frame captured chain; denv is a traced object
edge, not a separate arbitrary C root
registers
each processor ps->r array; compiler must spill actual
live machine values before synchronized GC
saved
each processor saved array; explicit SAVE macros
retain temporary Scheme arguments across allocating
calls
type-cache
each processor type_cache array
processor-object
each processor Scheme object body, including threaded
language state reachable through its fields
external-still
each processor setup traverses still chain and seeds
objects with nonzero external refcount; descendants
are scanned under active credit
rc-payload
registered h->data is a root slot; registration is per
PSTATE but only processor zero currently walks its RC
chain
ffi-temporary
Explicit marker proc needs a root before allocating;
implicit closure relies on RC and c_closure_self; Tcl
still vector already has external protection
weak-exclusion
Will testators and weak table edges follow weak
policy; do not add them as strong roots to make
coverage look complete; reachable actions follow
strong scan policy
manifest
Enumerate ten root families plus callback admission
and weak-phase exclusions; exact physical slot
completeness and supported configuration remain
separate obligations
writer-close
Close new register/write/read/unlink/exit admission,
drain accepted operations without holding GC-required
locks, then freeze root membership and payload
versions; current API does not implement this protocol
stable-scan
Scanner records stable owner, epoch and payload
version; a value read lease alone cannot prevent
set_data_rc or unlink; stale snapshot never issues a
receipt
idle-custody
idle decrements only after own root producers and all
private/published/scanner/derived responsibilities
settle; active credit transfers before a thief scans
receipt
Full root census plus same-epoch stable scans and no
outstanding owner duties permit a conditional closure
receipt; peer-return and storage retirement remain
separate
copy
Forwarding visibility does not discharge payload
initialization; copying call returns before caller can
idle
tail
PAIR first field follows inline tail, remaining field
follows body scan; tail completion cannot be inferred
from only scan_and_advance
cursor
Local alloc cursor is committed before control
returns; incomplete-chunk scan compares against
current alloc_heap_ptr
publication
Body/end marker/link precede published tail; active
producer covers synchronous call; independent
producers require explicit credit
scanner
Popped still node and dequeued chunk remain in live
native scanner frames; recursive children settle
before next idle attempt
still-derived
Movable scanning may enqueue still objects, so
still/movable local loop repeats until no still work
remains
idle
Under termination mutex, decrement only after local
drain/steal; waiter seeing zero returns without
reacquiring; nonzero wake reacquires first
root-scan
No additional graph traversal is required merely for
the receipt; added census bookkeeping and changed RC
coverage are real
credit
Existing worker count may cover work but cannot cover
omitted roots or uncontrolled FFI writers
rc-coverage
Additional RC scan cost is proportional to roots
previously omitted; this is correctness cost, not a
performance regression benchmark
